description.narrative: Title : Disaster management capacity strengthening Start and end dates: 01/12/2016 31/12/2019 (decision to extend to 2020) Pcode: P6490 Summary: Focus is on engaging communities in DRR; responding to disasters and strengthening work with refugee migrant and host communities. BRC will continue working alongside the ICRC and IFRC to stabilise the governance and management of the NS. BRC with Kenyan Red Cross to support the CRD and Djibouti government to develop Disaster Management legislation for the country. The programme has two output areas: 1) increase DRCS disaster management capacity and 2) responds to the needs of people affected by disasters in Djibouti . Location: Djibouti Beneficiaries: NA Donor: GF PNSs/Partners: BRC KRCS Djibouti RC Budget: 2016-2019 = 300 000. 75 000 annual budgeted for up to 2021 (GF) Current situation (Jan 2020): DM activities were previously put on hold to wait for NS to get governance structure in order. Djibouti Red Crescent (DRC) had first general assembly in sept 2019 last 15 years & have appointed interim board to work with current SG as he transitions out. Back on board with initial project meeting happened in Oct 2019 with team next week to review workplan and working on decision to extend activities into 2020. BRC eager to support development of DM legislation within Djibouti. Government have received funding from the World Bank for this purpose. KRC to provide initial support and roadmap for Djibouti Red Crescent/ government on creating the legislation.
